title: SignalOS: Important Systems
summary: Read the SignalOS signals, states, and failure clues that matter in play.

blocks.title: What To Watch
blocks.body: Drive templates, records, apps, archives, chapters, and missions can all add useful player-facing information, so check recovered drives before discarding them.

blocks.title: Player Signals
blocks.body: Watch drive labels, record presence, app role, archive state, rack or terminal compatibility, and whether a drive is unique enough to back up first.

blocks.title: Keep It Legible
blocks.body: A SignalOS system is working when another player could look at the state, understand the next action, and avoid the obvious failure.

blocks.title: State Check
blocks.body: Use the system note to read the current state, then choose one action that answers it.
